[BE A PART OF INSAN DD: MAGANGHUB BATCH 3 2026]🌟

Hello, Future Changemakers! Are you ready to kickstart your journey with a purpose?

Dompet Dhuafa's MagangHub Batch 3 2026 is officially open! This is your opportunity to blend professional growth with real-world social impact at one of Indonesia's leading Islamic philanthropy institutions.

We are looking for passionate individuals to join us as Insan DD in the following Internship Positions:
1️⃣ Quality Management System (QMS)
2️⃣ Customer Relationship Management (CRM)
3️⃣ Influencer Management

Don't miss out on this chance to gain hands-on experience and build your network. Take your first step toward making a difference today!

📌 How to Apply:
Scan the QR Code on the flyer or click the link below:
👉 bit.ly/MaganghubatDD

Tag a friend below who needs to see this!
